name: Gardening Store
unlock: Available after the first gardening tutorial route.
hours: Check during normal daytime town errands.
notes: Best first stop before crop-profit planning. Pair seed buys with a short-session crop route.

name: Furniture Workshop
unlock: Follow Bob's furniture route and early joinery requests.
hours: Plan this stop before house-design sessions.
notes: Main handoff for house layouts, material planning, and room-by-room design ideas.

name: Pet Shop
unlock: Use the pet-care onboarding path before broad food tests.
hours: Visit when routing cats, dogs, and birdwatching unlocks.
notes: Keep pet-shop cats and dogs separate from wild animal troughs and Oak-Oak.

name: Clothing Store
unlock: Progress Dorothy's fashion and poster route.
hours: Combine with Central Town NPC gift loops.
notes: Useful for fashion collection checks and seasonal outfit planning.

name: Annie's Music Store
unlock: Use after sheet-music and home-decoration systems appear.
notes: Connects house design with music collection and room-theme planning.

name: Ka Ching's General Store
unlock: Visit when inventory pressure starts blocking routes.
hours: Pair with any long gathering, fishing, or event loop.
notes: Use this before material-heavy routes so fishing and foraging sessions do not stall.

name: Doris Weather Cart
unlock: Appears around special weather states, rainbows, snow, or meteor routes.
hours: Patch-sensitive; confirm with the in-game map and weather forecast.
notes: Treat Doris as a dynamic merchant. Do not plan rare purchases without checking weather first.

name: Sea Fishing Booth
unlock: Use during Sea Fishing and fishing-event routes.
hours: Check when the events page points to fishing prep.
notes: Best paired with fish tracker, inventory checks, and event reward planning.
